source: EP-0169 (audit repo k4_blocks_phase_shift.py, decision rules committed before any K4 run; post hoc CM-Bifid count null k4_blocks_phase_shift_cmbcount.py), with follow-ups EP-0177, EP-0184 and EP-0178
procedure_notes: The positive controls (which do not use K4) were run before the pre-registration commit and included in it.
The keyword-square null was first run with 5 shuffles; after K4's 0 hits was seen it was increased to 100 and rerun (the 5-shuffle log was overwritten).
The CM-Bifid count null (100 shuffles, node cap 100,000) was added after the K4 result (post hoc).

EP-0177.what: crib-adjacent word fragments under the W-as-phrase-break reading; two sets fixed by rule from a book corpus before K4 (fragment lists not published)

FSfree.note: the 4 free Four-square fold/adj1 settings left open by EP-0157 (O-pair Note follow-up); the condition barely bites (11/12 out-of-set controls also remain)

EP-0177.verdict: not closed; enrichment not significant with 20 shuffles

EP-0184.what: plaintext candidate sets for positions 0-19 and 75-96, generated by rule and frozen before K4 (candidates not published)
EP-0184.FSfree: logically untouched: the fold/adj1 pairs never reach positions 0-19 or 70-91 of the reduced text; forced before testing
EP-0184.verdict: CM-Bifid closed only under the assumed candidate sets, and the elimination is typical of shuffles (96 %); FSfree undecidable

EP-0178.what: a typo-tolerant English 4-gram scorer (up to 2 substitutions, exact, checked against brute force); a tool, not applied to K4
EP-0178.note: at length 97 the original scorer already separates English from shuffles with 0-2 substitutions; the gain is in windows of about 30 letters
